{"step":2,"file":"wpantund/src/wpantund/NCPInstanceBase.cpp","function":"NCPInstanceBase::NCPInstanceBase","line":141,"var":"mPrimaryInterface->mAddressWasRemoved","code":"mPrimaryInterface->mAddressWasRemoved.connect(boost::bind(&NCPInstanceBase::unicast_address_was_removed, this, kOriginPrimaryInterface, _1));","note":"Primary-interface address removals are forwarded into NCPInstanceBase::unicast_address_was_removed."},
{"step":3,"file":"wpantund/src/wpantund/NCPInstanceBase-Addresses.cpp","function":"NCPInstanceBase::on_mesh_prefix_was_removed","line":923,"var":"address","code":"unicast_address_was_removed(kOriginThreadNCP, address);","note":"When a SLAAC address is removed as part of prefix teardown, the code re-enters the unicast removal path with Thread-NCP origin."},
{"step":4,"file":"wpantund/src/wpantund/NCPInstanceBase-Addresses.cpp","function":"NCPInstanceBase::on_mesh_prefix_was_removed","line":915,"var":"addr_iter","code":"addr_iter = find_address_with_prefix(prefix, kOriginThreadNCP);","note":"Prefix removal looks up the matching SLAAC unicast address that was previously added from the NCP."},
{"step":5,"file":"wpantund/src/wpantund/NCPInstanceBase-Addresses.cpp","function":"NCPInstanceBase::on_mesh_prefix_was_removed","line":918,"var":"address","code":"remove_unicast_address_on_ncp(address, prefix_len, ...);","note":"The matching SLAAC address is removed from the NCP before local bookkeeping is updated."},
{"step":6,"file":"wpantund/src/wpantund/NCPInstanceBase-Addresses.cpp","function":"NCPInstanceBase::unicast_address_was_removed","line":621,"var":"entry","code":"UnicastAddressEntry entry = mUnicastAddresses[address];","note":"The removal handler retrieves the tracked entry and uses its metadata to decide whether to propagate the removal."},

{"step":8,"file":"wpantund/src/util/TunnelIPv6Interface.cpp","function":"TunnelIPv6Interface::remove_address","line":447,"var":"addr","code":"if (mUnicastAddresses.count(*addr)) { mUnicastAddresses.erase(*addr); }","note":"The tunnel interface erases its own tracking entry before issuing the kernel removal request."},
{"step":9,"file":"wpantund/src/util/TunnelIPv6Interface.cpp","function":"TunnelIPv6Interface::remove_address","line":452,"var":"addr->s6_addr","code":"if (netif_mgmt_remove_ipv6_address(mNetifMgmtFD, mInterfaceName.c_str(), addr->s6_addr) != 0) { ... }","note":"The sink dereferences the caller-provided address after local state may already have been invalidated, matching the reported use-after-free read."}
